scope: Read-only independent mathematical/code audit; fixed1220 chemistry runs retain full official verification as the acceptance gate

conclusions.reason: Gaussian row elimination is reversed to synthesize the linear map; transpose reverses gate order and reverses CX direction. Output X translations implement the affine offset. Each accepted block independently recomputes the same affine map. Nonlinear, measurement, phase and explicit condition operations are retained as barriers.

conclusions.result: Correct SWAP expansion and reachable phase check for the actual full table
conclusions.reason: SWAP is represented by its exact three-CX identity only in the proof representation. Candidate KMB SHA is checked before proving all15 forward/reverse endpoints. Source reported operation counts distinguish native SWAP from expanded CX.

conclusions.result: W/H2_I-only replacement and full official acceptance are correctly scoped
conclusions.reason: Both changed arrays are finite and shape checked. Supplied angle_words/tree_edges mismatches are rejected. The saved NPZ begins from the complete baseline and replaces only W and H2_I. A supplied portfolio receipt binds exact baseline NPZ and all15 loaders, PASS78080 and comparison cost; absent receipt comparison is labeled numeric only. The official verify implementation either returns PASS or raises. Roundoff tolerance prevents a few ULPs being called a gain.

conclusions.result: Actual candidate NPZ and complete official acceptance are correctly scoped
conclusions.reason: NPZ is copied byte for byte and SHA checked. Baseline comparison binds a prior full official PASS, NPZ and verifier hashes. Actual candidate must PASS78080 through unchanged official code. No public score or beating user loggedlambda is inferred.

findings.issue: In the reviewed versions the table is cast to uint64 before checking integer dtype, exact shape(1220,75) and 8bit bounds. A short or empty table can yield a correspondingly partial or vacuous reachable proof despite the broad status label.
findings.impact_on_existing_runs: None identified: actual tables are the full pinned original and the candidates also have full78080 official PASS.
findings.recommendation: Validate source angle_words shape/dtype/range before cast and record table_sha256. Parent was notified; any later patched source hash belongs in a new manifest, leaving historical run hashes intact.
findings.resolution: Owner added checked_angle_words before conversion in both entry points: exact(1220,75), integer dtype and0..255. Validator records table SHA and exact36600 scope; optional reference table is explicitly compared, replacing the unconditional unchanged assertion.

limits: The affine reducer is a local heuristic, not a global Clifford minimum.
Raw operations and three-CX-expanded operations are different metrics; both are reported.
Passing the local block or reachable proof alone is not full chemistry or public-score acceptance.
This audit does not rerun the official 78080-shot verifier.
